questions.q: How many labelled training images are shown, and what are their labels?
questions.key: Five: deer, bird, plane, cat, car.

questions.q: What is the query image, and why is it marked?

questions.q: What does the distance metric take as input and what does it return?
questions.key: Two images; it returns a single real number.

questions.q: How does the nearest neighbour classifier decide the label of the query?
questions.key: It gives the query the label of the training image with the smallest distance, here cat.

questions.q: What is the L1 distance between the two images in the example?
What is the value in the top left cell of the test image, and of the training image?
How is each cell of the third grid computed?
